Name: Harvest Moon FoMT-like Watering Can And Hoe Area
Author: Goldenrevolver
Description:
[size=3][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.1 and SMAPI 4.0.1. Source available on Github:
[url=https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods]https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods[/url][/color]


This mod changes the early watering can area to resemble the way it worked in Harvest Moon FoMT, wide, not long: 1x3, 2x3, 3x3 instead of 3x1, 5x1, 3x3.

This way you can use the watering can the way you (and your muscle memory) are used to.

[color=#6aa84f]Works well with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7768]Watering Grants Experience[/url]﻿ to give you an incentive to upgrade it and use it for longer.[/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7851/7851-1611967380-942429589.gif[/img]﻿

Summary on the progression changes:

Copper:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]before: 3x1, 3 tiles total[/size]
[*][size=3]after: 1x3, 3 tiles total[/size]
[/list][size=3]Steel:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]before: 5x1, 5 tiles total[/size]
[*][size=3]after: 2x3, [color=#6aa84f]6 tiles total[/color][/size]
[/list][size=3]Gold, Iridium:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]same as before[/size]
[/list][size=3]Iridium+Reach:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]before: 5x5, 25 tiles total[/size]
[*][size=3]after: 6x5,[color=#6aa84f] 30 tiles total[/color] (allows to water the greenhouse with 4 uses instead of 6, can be disabled in the config)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
The mod also fixes the base game animation bug with the reach enchantment of the water going the wrong way around in 3 of 4 directions:

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7851/7851-1611950015-1635218977.gif[/img]

I also gave a minor adjustment to the hoe to not leave it behind and give it a multiple of 3:

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7851/7851-1611949990-1035943171.gif[/img]﻿

Summary on the progression changes:

Copper:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]same as before[/size]
[/list][size=3]Steel:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]before: 5x1, 5 tiles total[/size]
[*][size=3]after: 6x1,[color=#6aa84f] 6 tiles total[/color][/size]
[/list][size=3]Gold, Iridium:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]same as before[/size]
[/list][size=3]Iridium+Reach:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]before: 5x5, 25 tiles total[/size]
[*][size=3]after: 6x5,[color=#6aa84f] 30 tiles total[/color] (allows to hoe the greenhouse with 4 uses instead of 6, can be disabled in the config)[/size]
[/list][size=3]


Compatibility:
[color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10612]Moon Misadventures[/url], which adds multiple new tiers for tools.
[color=#6aa84f]Compatible [/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7630]Radioactive Tools[/url], but it's [color=#f1c232]outdated [/color]and I don't recommend using it currently (fyi: Moon Misadventures also adds radioactive tools).


Requirements:
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]: I built version 1.2.1 of this mod based on version 4.0.1. It should be compatible with a few future versions and a few prior version. You can get the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].


Installation:
Install SMAPI. Then extract the content of the downloaded zip file into the SMAPI mods folder and start the game via the SMAPI launcher or Steam if you have set the launch option for SMAPI in Steam.


Updating: 
Simply delete the prior version and install the new one.


Uninstallation:
You can delete this mod from your mods folder at any time to remove the features.[/size]
